# Cálculo del PIB

```{r}
#Función para calcular el PIB
calc_pib <- function(model_obj, model_ref = NULL) {
    # model_ref: modelo base cuyos precios se usan para valorar el PIB real
    # (Laspeyres). Si es NULL se usan los precios del propio modelo, lo que solo
    # es correcto para el escenario base.
    ss_vals  <- get_ss_values(model_obj, silent = TRUE)
    par_vals <- get_par_values(model_obj, silent = TRUE)
    ss_ref   <- if (is.null(model_ref)) ss_vals else get_ss_values(model_ref, silent = TRUE)

    p_names <- unlist(cfg$productos)
    p_eq  <- ss_vals[paste0("p__",  p_names)]
    pq_eq <- ss_vals[paste0("pq__", p_names)]   # precio de comprador (incluye IVA)

    # Componentes del gasto a precios de mercado: GDP = C + G + I + V + X - M
    inv_adj_val <- ss_vals["inv_adj"]
    if (is.na(inv_adj_val) || length(inv_adj_val) == 0) inv_adj_val <- 1.0
    D_q <- ss_vals[paste0("D__", p_names)]
    G_q <- par_vals[paste0("gg_market_data_p__", p_names)]
    I_q <- par_vals[paste0("I_data__", p_names)]
    V_q <- par_vals[paste0("vexist__", p_names)]

    C     <- sum(D_q * pq_eq, na.rm = TRUE)
    G_val <- sum(G_q * pq_eq, na.rm = TRUE)
    I_val <- sum(I_q * pq_eq, na.rm = TRUE) * inv_adj_val
    V_val <- sum(V_q * p_eq,  na.rm = TRUE)          # existencias sin IVA

    pe_eq  <- ss_vals[paste0("pe__", p_names)]
    E_vals <- ss_vals[paste0("EX__", p_names)]
    X_val  <- sum(E_vals * pe_eq, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Importaciones a precio CIF (pworldm * exr), sin aranceles
    pwm_eq  <- par_vals[paste0("pworldm__", p_names)]
    exr_val <- ss_vals["exr"]
    M_vals  <- ss_vals[paste0("M__", p_names)]
    M_val   <- sum(M_vals * pwm_eq * exr_val, na.rm = TRUE)

    # PIB real: cantidades del escenario valoradas a precios del modelo de referencia
    pq_ref  <- ss_ref[paste0("pq__", p_names)]
    p_ref   <- ss_ref[paste0("p__",  p_names)]
    pe_ref  <- ss_ref[paste0("pe__", p_names)]
    exr_ref <- ss_ref["exr"]
    C_real <- sum(D_q * pq_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
    G_real <- sum(G_q * pq_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
    I_real <- sum(I_q * pq_ref, na.rm = TRUE) * inv_adj_val
    V_real <- sum(V_q * p_ref,  na.rm = TRUE)
    X_real <- sum(E_vals * pe_ref, na.rm = TRUE)
    M_real <- sum(M_vals * pwm_eq * exr_ref, na.rm = TRUE)

    return(list(C=C, G=G_val, I=I_val, V=V_val, X=X_val, M=M_val,
                PIB = C + G_val + I_val + V_val + X_val - M_val,
                C_real=C_real, G_real=G_real, I_real=I_real, V_real=V_real, X_real=X_real, M_real=M_real,
                PIB_real = C_real + G_real + I_real + V_real + X_real - M_real,
                u_rate = ss_vals[paste0("u_rate__", unlist(cfg$cuentas_sam$factores$trabajo))],
                Tax = ss_vals["Tax"],
                FIRMTAX = ss_vals["FIRMTAX"],
                PITAX = ss_vals["PITAX"],
                VAT = ss_vals["VAT"],
                TPROD = ss_vals["TPROD"],
                TESP = ss_vals["TESP"],
                TARANCEL = ss_vals["TARANCEL"]))
}
```

```{r}
# Cálculo y Descomposición del PIB (Enfoque del Gasto)
PIB_SAM <- sum(D_m) + sum(G_m) + sum(I_m) + sum(V_m) + sum(E_m) - sum(M_m)
cat("\nDescomposición del PIB (Enfoque del Gasto) - Valores SAM:\n")
cat("Consumo Hogares (C):       ", round(sum(D_m), 2), "\n")
cat("Consumo Gobierno (G):      ", round(sum(G_m), 2), "\n")
cat("Inversión (I):             ", round(sum(I_m), 2), "\n")
cat("Var. Existencias (V):      ", round(sum(V_m), 2), "\n")
cat("Exportaciones (X):         ", round(sum(E_m), 2), "\n")
cat("Importaciones (M) (-):     ", round(sum(M_m), 2), "\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("PIB Total:                 ", round(PIB_SAM, 2), "\n\n")

# Resultados base
res_base <- get_ss_values(model)
pib_model_list <- calc_pib(model)
pib_base <- pib_model_list$PIB
pib_real_base <- pib_model_list$PIB_real

pib_df <- data.frame(
    Componente = c("Consumo_Hog", "Consumo_Gob", "Inversion", "Var_Exist", "Exports", "Imports_(-)", "PIB_Total"),
    SAM_Base = c(sum(D_m), sum(G_m), sum(I_m), sum(V_m), sum(E_m), sum(M_m), PIB_SAM),
    Modelo_Eq = c(pib_model_list$C, pib_model_list$G, pib_model_list$I, 
                  pib_model_list$V, pib_model_list$X, pib_model_list$M, pib_base)
)
pib_df$Diferencia <- round(pib_df$Modelo_Eq - pib_df$SAM_Base, 6)
print(pib_df)
```
